identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Make claim recovery independent of unrelated terminal drift and stale design inputs

values.task_boundary: Record and publish the product/test patch for issue #5737 from the existing worktree.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Unrelated stale terminal identity cannot block non-overlapping init, bind, or reacquire.
AC-2: A dormant issue with changed design inputs can reacquire authority and then use typed design reapproval.
AC-3: Real overlapping live claims still fail closed.
AC-4: Stale projections whose claim branch/worktree do not match their active checkout do not act as collision authority.
AC-5: Focused Gate 2 tests and strict Clippy pass.
dependencies: existing C-SDLC v2 claim and store APIs
repo-native v2 binaries from adl-wp-5107 target/debug
